pick.title: Duosida wallbox
pick.description: These wallboxes answered on the local network. Pick one, or enter the IP address yourself. A static DHCP lease is recommended. Close the Duosida app first: the wallbox accepts very few local connections.

manual.title: Duosida wallbox: IP address
manual.description: Enter the IP address of the wallbox. It must be on the same network as Home Assistant; a static DHCP lease is recommended. Close the Duosida app first: the wallbox accepts very few local connections.

data_description.host: IP address of the wallbox, for example 192.168.1.50

reconfigure_pick.title: Change the wallbox address
reconfigure_pick.description: Pick the new address of this wallbox, or enter it yourself. The integration reconnects afterwards; the wallbox may need about a minute before it accepts the new session.

reconfigure_manual.title: Change the wallbox address
reconfigure_manual.description: Enter the new IP address. It is checked over UDP (the running session is not disturbed); the integration then reconnects, which can take about a minute.

data_description.host: IP address of the wallbox, for example 192.168.1.50

error.cannot_connect: The wallbox did not answer on this address and port. It may also be busy for about a minute after another local connection closed; try again later.
error.wrong_device: A different wallbox answered on this address (MAC address does not match).

data_description.poll_interval: How often status and meter values are requested. Saving reconnects the session, which can take about a minute.
